meanings.usage: 指形状奇怪、体积庞大的生物，常用于描述未知或传说中的生物
指在船上工作的人，与 fisherman 不同，后者指以捕鱼为生的人
泛指任何动物或生物，语气比 animal 更为文学化
强调与众不同的、稀奇古怪的，常用结构：be peculiar to 某地特有的
描述力量大、影响力强，可用于形容人或事物的力量
指一般的、没有特别之处的，反义词为 extraordinary
表示经过一段时间或努力之后的结果，近义词为 finally, in the end
指仔细检查或研究，常用结构：examine + n. / examine + wh-从句
指从表面到下面的距离，常用结构：at a depth of... 在...深度
指不经常发生，频率介于 sometimes 和 rarely 之间
表示几乎不、难得，含有否定含义，用于句首时后接倒装
指断言某事是真实的，常含有未必属实的意味
指视力或看见的状态，catch sight of 看到；at sight 一见就
指突然明白或意识到某事，后接 that 从句或 wh-从句
指被水流冲到某处，常用被动 be washed to 被冲到

phrases.usage: 表示偶尔、有时，相当于 sometimes，用于描述不经常发生的情况

examples.en: At times I feel tired after work.
examples.zh: 有时我下班后会感到累。

phrases.usage: no + adj. 表示强调，意为'绝非普通的'，用来突出事物的特殊性

examples.en: This is no ordinary question.
examples.zh: 这绝不是一个普通的问题。

phrases.usage: 表示尽一切努力、不遗余力，后接 to do sth.

examples.en: He made every effort to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 他尽一切努力准时到达。

phrases.usage: 表示被（海浪）冲到岸边，wash 还有'冲刷、洗涤'的意思

examples.en: The debris was washed to the beach by the waves.
examples.zh: 碎片被海浪冲到了海滩上。

phrases.usage: 表示拉鱼线，pull on 表示用力拉扯某物，line 在此指钓鱼线

examples.en: The fish pulled hard on the line.
examples.zh: 那条鱼用力拉鱼线。

phrases.usage: 表示以任何方式，常用于否定句中加强语气，意为'丝毫不'

examples.en: I don't want to trouble you in any way.
examples.zh: 我丝毫不想麻烦你。

phrases.usage: 表示被送往博物馆，set 在此为过去分词，表示'被放置、被送往'

examples.en: The painting was set to the National Gallery.
examples.zh: 这幅画被送到了国家美术馆。

phrases.usage: 表示生活在...深度，depth 前可加具体数字

examples.en: These fish live at a depth of 300 meters.
examples.zh: 这些鱼生活在300米深处。

phrases.usage: 表示嘲笑、讥笑，也可表示'对...一笑了之'

examples.en: Don't laugh at his mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑他的错误。

phrases.usage: 表示把某人带到海上，carry 有'携带、带走'之意，此处指被鱼拖走

examples.en: The storm carried the boat out to sea.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把船带到了海上。

sentences.en: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
sentences.zh: 渔民和水手有时声称在海中见过怪物。

sentences.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen,
sentences.zh: 尽管人们常常嘲笑水手们讲述的故事，

sentences.en: it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
sentences.zh: 但现在已知，这些有时被目击到的“怪物”很多只是奇怪的鱼。

sentences.en: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，不寻常的生物会被冲到岸边，但它们很少在海上被捕获。

sentences.en: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
sentences.zh: 然而，不久前，一条奇特的鱼在马达加斯加附近被捕获。

sentences.en: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
sentences.zh: 当这条强壮的鱼拉扯鱼线时，一艘小渔船被拖离海岸数英里。

sentences.en: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
sentences.zh: 渔民意识到这不是一条普通的鱼，便竭尽全力不损坏它。

sentences.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
sentences.zh: 当它最终被带到岸上时，发现它有十三英尺多长。

sentences.en: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
sentences.zh: 它有一个像马一样的头，大大的蓝眼睛，闪亮的银色皮肤和一条鲜红的尾巴。

sentences.en: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
sentences.zh: 这条鱼后来被送往博物馆，由科学家进行研究，它被称为皇带鱼。

sentences.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
sentences.zh: 这种生物很少被人类活体发现，因为它们生活在六百英尺深的地方。

exercises.prompt: “罕见地；很少” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: rarely · /ˈreəli/ · adv · 罕见地；很少。表示几乎不、难得，含有否定含义，用于句首时后接倒装

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：声称；宣称
exercises.explain: claim · /kleɪm/ · verb · 声称；宣称。指断言某事是真实的，常含有未必属实的意味

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：I don't want to trouble you _____.
exercises.explain: in any way：表示以任何方式，常用于否定句中加强语气，意为'丝毫不'（我丝毫不想麻烦你。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being _____ by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
exercises.hint: 这条鱼后来被送往博物馆，由科学家进行研究，它被称为皇带鱼。
exercises.explain: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish. — 这条鱼后来被送往博物馆，由科学家进行研究，它被称为皇带鱼。

source.en: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.

exercises.prompt: “1. 用逗号与主句隔开 2. 关系代词 which 可指代整个主句 3. 不能用 that 引导” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 主句 + , + 关系代词/关系副词 + 从句 / 主句 + , + which/who + 句子
options: would you mind + 动名词 (Polite Requests)
exercises.explain: 定语从句（非限定性）：主句 + , + 关系代词/关系副词 + 从句 / 主句 + , + which/who + 句子：1. 用逗号与主句隔开 2. 关系代词 which 可指代整个主句 3. 不能用 that 引导

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
options: 我被要求在车辆很多的道路上驾驶，并成功完成了。
当它最终被带到岸上时，发现它有十三英尺多长。
在山区坠毁，飞行员当场丧生。
exercises.explain: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long. — 当它最终被带到岸上时，发现它有十三英尺多长。

source.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.

grammar.title: 定语从句（非限定性）
grammar.definition: 非限定性定语从句对先行词进行补充说明，去掉后不影响主句意义，从句前后有逗号隔开
grammar.structure: 主句 + , + 关系代词/关系副词 + 从句 / 主句 + , + which/who + 句子
grammar.usage: 1. 用逗号与主句隔开 2. 关系代词 which 可指代整个主句 3. 不能用 that 引导

examples.en: The fish, which has been sent to a museum, is called an oarfish.
examples.zh: 那条鱼被称为皇带鱼，已被送往博物馆。

examples.en: Mary, who is waiting outside, wants to see you.
examples.zh: 玛丽在外面等着，想见你。

examples.en: The meeting, which held last week, was a success.
examples.zh: 上周举行的会议很成功。

grammar.title: It is now known that... 句型
grammar.definition: it is known that 是一个常用句型，意为'众所周知'，it 是形式主语，真正的主语是 that 引导的从句
grammar.structure: It is + known/reported/believed + that + 从句
grammar.usage: 1. it 作形式主语，避免句子头重脚轻 2. 类似结构：It is said that... 据说；It is believed that... 据认为 3. 可以转换为：People know (that)...

examples.en: It is now known that many 'monsters' are simply strange fish.
examples.zh: 现在已知，许多'怪物'不过是奇怪的鱼。

examples.en: It is known that he is the best student in the class.
examples.zh: 众所周知，他是班里最好的学生。

examples.en: It is said that the restaurant is very good.
examples.zh: 据说那家餐厅很不错。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语
grammar.definition: 过去分词作定语时，放在被修饰名词之前（单个过去分词）或之后（过去分词短语），表示被动和完成意义
grammar.structure: 名词 + 过去分词 / 名词 + 过去分词短语
grammar.usage: 1. 及物动词的过去分词表示被动和完成 2. 单个过去分词作定语时放在名词前 3. 过去分词短语作定语时放在名词后，相当于定语从句

examples.en: The fish caught near Madagascar was over thirteen feet long.
examples.zh: 在马达加斯加附近捕获的鱼有13英尺多长。

examples.en: The boy named Tom is my brother.
examples.zh: 叫汤姆的男孩是我弟弟。

examples.en: The fish (which was) caught yesterday is still alive.
examples.zh: 昨天捕到的那条鱼还活着。

original.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these 'monsters' are simply strange fish.
original.zh: 尽管人们经常嘲笑海员讲的故事，但现在已知这些'怪物'中有许多只是奇怪的鱼。

examples.en: Though she is young, she speaks English very well.
examples.zh: 虽然她很年轻，但她英语说得很好。

examples.en: Though it was raining hard, we went out.
examples.zh: 虽然雨下得很大，我们还是出去了。

patterns.pattern: A + 名词 + was + 过去分词 + 地点/时间

original.en: A peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
original.zh: 一条奇特的鱼在马达加斯加附近被捕获。

examples.en: A rare bird was spotted in the forest.
examples.zh: 一只珍稀鸟在森林里被发现。

examples.en: A beautiful painting was sold at auction.
examples.zh: 一幅美丽的画在拍卖会上被售出。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + make(s) every effort + to do

original.en: The fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
original.zh: 渔民尽一切努力不损坏它。

examples.en: She made every effort to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 她尽一切努力按时完成工作。

examples.en: We made every effort to help the poor family.
examples.zh: 我们尽一切努力帮助这个贫困家庭。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + by + 动作执行者

original.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
original.zh: 这类生物很少被人类活着看到，因为它们生活在600英尺深处。

examples.en: The painting has been examined by experts.
examples.zh: 这幅画已被专家检查过。

examples.en: The story has been told by many people.
examples.zh: 这个故事已被许多人讲述过。
